wizard role should read through mechanism rather than one prop: scholarly archive, technomancy interface, contract logomancy, micro-object levitation, or restoration-lab material anomaly can each be the main axis

archive evidence such as grimoire or star-map notes remains available, but it is only one axis among modern devices, sealed records, gift-tag ledgers, small levitation shadows, and contact-point refraction

unless the user explicitly asks for sci-fi, robot, android, cyborg, data-ghost, alien, or machine-interface magic, do not add visible tech visors, antenna headsets, sensor bands, status LED badges, maintenance QR wristbands, data-port collars, lidar scan dots, machine-vision camera views, robot diagnostics, lens-array focus, exposed-joint focus, boot-flicker motion, cable-fiber textures, liquid-metal textures, synthetic-skin textures, brushed-alloy robot textures, or AR hologram UI as the main spell evidence
distinct from stage magician: no playing-card fan, tailcoat, top hat, audience performance, or sleight-of-hand stagecraft should dominate the image

power should feel controlled and costly through one concrete local world response: paper stirring without wind, textless marks rearranging, a screen pulse, contact refraction, or a few-centimeter levitation with a believable shadow; avoid routine glowing magic circles, generic blue aura, explosive blasts, combat, gore, sacrifice, or injury

the active spell should visibly change matter or force in the photographed space, not only display symbols: paper chars, ink climbs uphill, frost grows, wax melts and resolidifies, thread tightens, salt vibrates, dust is displaced, crystals grow, candle flames bend, air ripples, or a real object levitates with a cast shadow
wizard or mage as hidden-order reader across archive, lab, office, contract, device, and micro-object mechanisms; magic appears as local transformation plus cost or trace
